notes.title: ⚡ Fast Mode Update!
notes.content:
Patch Notes – New Update! 🎉

🏹 Two New Knights: Say hello to Thorn and Century—long-range specialists ready for action!
⏱️ Timer Mode: Race against the clock and beat your personal best!
⚡ Faster Game Speed: The game is now quicker and more intense than ever.
🛡️ New Challenge Modes: Take on the ultimate tests in True DodgeKing Mode and the pulse-pounding HeartBeat Mode.
🖥️ 16:10 Ratio Support: Play the game on your preferred monitor with full support for 16:10 ratio!
✨ New Effects and Feels: Enhanced visuals and immersive new effects.
⚖️ Balance Patches: Various gameplay tweaks for a smoother experience.

Jump in and feel the difference! 🚀

notes.title: ⚔️ Deluxe Patch - Gameplay Tweaks added
notes.content:
Attention Knights! ⚔️

A fresh patch has arrived, and with it, some exciting updates! Plus, an enhanced demo is just around the corner! Check out the latest changes:

🔥 Merror's new ability: When you take damage, the enemy does too! Time to turn the tides. 
🖼️ Updated UI: A brand-new interface for smoother gameplay is now ready. 
🎁 New Reward Mode: Dodge to get Attack, Shield, and HP Boosts! 
⚖️ Game Balance: Fine-tuned for a better challenge. 
🎨 Stage Recoloring: New color filter added to smoothen visuals. 
📖 Tutorial Resequenced: Learn the ropes in a smoother order. 
♾️ Endless Mode: Rarities have been adjusted for endless fun. 
👹 Relic Tweaks: Ambush, Knight Guard, and more were buffed! 
🎉 Level-Up Notifications: Never miss out on that sweet power-up moment.

Good luck becoming the DodgeKing with the new set of challenges that await!

notes.title: Major Patch...
notes.content:
Lots of lessons were learned after launching DodgeKing! It's important to focus on the next project but since there'll be a key integration aspect that I prefer not to spoil, DodgeKing will be rehauling and updating a major amount of features/mechanics in order to best optimize the game into new levels. 

tl;dr - more content, fun, and modes coming soon!

notes.title: Double Down Mode
notes.content:
Knight,

You did an amazing run but just near the end, you got sniped by a terrible Symphlight, right?
Frustrating isn't it?

Well, the crown will not enrage itself and unlock Double Down Mode after you lose a deep run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42790401/a61c9bed4e7c973553c70ee12688e30f729c98ed.png[/img]

Boost your knight in a risk-it-all run to gain the best possible results, but will you be able to burden the curses of an Angry Crown?

Double Down Mode Includes:
- Possibility to Boost your Stats to crazy levels such as...
[list]
[*] Boosts that grant 20 Attack, 20 Shields
[*] Enable Critical Hits and do Double Damage (Stackable with Popcorn Punch)
[*] Extend your Shield's longevity or iFrames by x4
[/list]
- Legendary Weapons that grant Super Powers
[list]
[*] Insane Attack Boosts at the Cost of Dropping all Shields...
[*] Insane Sheilds Boosts, but start without Health...
[/list]

In exchange, disable yourself with a dreadful amount of curses that make the game much, much more challenging...
[list]
[*] Choas Mode Enables, More Robots Spawn, 
[*] Disabled Controls, Abilities, Weapons,
[*] Faster, Smarter, Stronger Robots...
[/list]

Do you think you have what it takes to dodge better?

notes.title: Optimized Gameplay!
notes.content:
Hey Knights, 
We heard your feedback and patched in fixes to optimize gameplay!

[list]
[*] Telepgraphed movement from Robots appears via Electrical Sparks
[*] Reverse Enemies are now more common!
[*] Power-Ups/Upgrades are fixed, and bonus effects work all the time.
[*] Tutorial will automatically be skipped after doing it once!
[/list]
